claim: In full-year 2025, Tesla saw revenue increase 3% from a year earlier.
summary: As of the knowledge cutoff of 2026-01-04, Tesla had not yet released Q4 2025 / full-year 2025 earnings (typically released late January). No verified full-year 2025 revenue figure was available to confirm a 3% year-over-year increase, so the claim cannot be established from pre-cutoff knowledge alone.

sub_claims.text: Tesla's revenue in full-year 2025 was higher than in full-year 2024
sub_claims.stated_text: revenue increase 3% from a year earlier
sub_claims.note: No finalized FY2025 revenue was published as of cutoff 2026-01-04; Q4 2025 results were pending, so YoY direction for full year cannot be verified.

sub_claims.text: The year-over-year increase in Tesla's full-year 2025 revenue versus full-year 2024 was 3%
sub_claims.note: Specific 3% growth rate for FY2025 cannot be verified without official FY2025 audited revenue; only Q1-Q3 2025 interim results were available pre-cutoff.
